# `workspace/Panel.js`

> **Source:** `plauna/workspace/Panel.js`

Panel.js — Base panel and two concrete flavours: DOMPanel  — a positioned <div> container for Plauna widgets / HTML content GPUPanel  — owns a GPUTexture render target; blitted to canvas by WorkspaceCompositor Lifecycle:  create → mount(container) → [resize / focus / show / hide] → destroy()

## Classes

### `class Panel`

Panel - Base class for workspace panels. Architecture pattern: - Abstract base class for DOMPanel and GPUPanel - Lifecycle: create → mount → [resize/focus/show/hide] → destroy - Observer pattern for event emission (move, resize, visibility, focus, blur) - Position/size constraints with min-size enforcement - Z-index management for panel stacking Panel types: - DOMPanel: Renders Plauna widgets in DOM elements - GPUPanel: Renders to WebGPU textures, composited by WorkspaceCompositor

| `destroy` | `destroy()` | Destroy panel and release resources. Lifecycle cleanup: - Sets mounted flag to false - Clears all observers to prevent memory leaks - Subclasses override to remove DOM elements or release GPU resources |

## Notes & Examples

### App & widget lifecycle

Plauna apps and widgets follow a **mount → update → unmount** lifecycle; services (storage, command bus, theming) are *injected* rather than imported, so the same widget runs in the editor, the OS shell, and standalone.

**See also:** [Plauna Architecture](/plauna/architecture.md) · [Plauna Overview](/plauna/overview.md)

### App & widget lifecycle

Plauna apps and widgets follow a **mount → update → unmount** lifecycle; services (storage, command bus, theming) are *injected* rather than imported, so the same widget runs in the editor, the OS shell, and standalone.

**Example: Widget with full lifecycle**
```js
import { Widget } from 'plauna/core/Widget.js';
import { useStorage, useCommands } from 'plauna/hooks.js';

class CounterWidget extends Widget {
  mount(container, services) {
    // Inject dependencies
    this.storage = useStorage(services);
    this.commands = useCommands(services);
    
    this.el = document.createElement('div');
    this.count = this.storage.get('count', 0);
    this.render();
    container.appendChild(this.el);
    
    // Register commands
    this.commands.register('counter:reset', () => {
      this.count = 0;
      this.render();
    });
  }
  
  update(props) {
    if (props.increment) this.count++;
    this.render();
  }
  
  render() {
    this.el.textContent = `Count: ${this.count}`;
    this.storage.set('count', this.count);
  }
  
  unmount() {
    this.commands.unregister('counter:reset');
    this.el.remove();
  }
}
```

**See also:** [Plauna Architecture](/plauna/architecture.md) · [Plauna Overview](/plauna/overview.md)
